# BgRemove

> A free online background remover. Selected images are processed in the browser and exported as PNGs with transparent backgrounds.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bgremove.ankuaitools.com): Remove an image background, review the cutout, and download a PNG.
- [About](https://bgremove.ankuaitools.com/about): How browser-based processing and PNG export work.
- [Blog](https://bgremove.ankuaitools.com/blog): Practical background removal and transparent PNG guides.
- [Privacy](https://bgremove.ankuaitools.com/privacy): Image handling and website network requests.
- [Terms](https://bgremove.ankuaitools.com/terms): Terms and output-use limitations.

## Tool details

- Price: Free to use; no account required.
- Input formats: PNG, JPG, and WEBP.
- Download: PNG with a 3840 × 2160 pixel canvas; the tool does not add a watermark.
- Processing: The selected image is processed in the browser. The website and model files still load in the browser.
- Background options: Transparent, white, black, or brand color in the editor.
- Limitations: Enlarging a small source does not add detail, and automatic cutouts can need review.
